lessons: Parse object names at the last underscore; category strings may contain underscores.
Use basket dimensions and orientation rather than a broad fixed proximity threshold.
Assign distinct baskets to categories using current perception, preserving unambiguous existing groupings.
Scene heights are nominal category planes, not measured dynamic heights. Lift-height, disappearance, and instance suffixes cannot verify a grasp.
Explicit no_collision_free_path responses mean zero trajectory execution; allow at most one alternate-arm precontact planning fallback.
After contact, do not retry uncertain manipulation or release at an arbitrary failure location.
Use modest clearance rather than large upward excursions, and keep all loops bounded.
